q033.question: Which features would help in a crowded city parking space?
q033.answer: Rear parking sensors come standard across all CRETA variants to help guide you. A rear camera with dynamic guidelines is standard on trims like EX(O), S(O), and higher, while front parking sensors and a surround view monitor are standard on SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition. An electric parking brake with auto hold is also fitted on King, King Knight, Lounge Edition, and automatic versions of S(O), S(O) Knight, and SX Premium.
